summary: This note is a short wiki entry about the character Amy in the TV series Animal Kingdom, played by Jennifer Landon in season 2. Amy works at a megachurch, where Pope meets and dates her. She also runs a Bible study group and an ex-con rehabilitation program there. The note contains no further detail.
